hooks.command: REPO="/c/Users/inhon/Documents/GitHub/bookStory"; LAST=$(git -C "$REPO" log -1 --format=%ct 2>/dev/null || echo 0); NOW=$(date +%s); DIFF=$((NOW - LAST)); CHANGES=$(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude)**/__pycache__/**' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$DIFF" -gt 10800 ] && [ -n "$CHANGES" ]; then FILES=$(echo "$CHANGES" | cut -c4- | head -8 | paste -sd, - | sed 's/,/, /g'); COUNT=$(echo "$CHANGES" | wc -l); if [ "$COUNT" -gt 8 ]; then FILES="$FILES 외 $((COUNT-8))개"; fi; MSG="auto-commit ($(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')): 수정 - $FILES"; git -C "$REPO" add -A -- . ':(exclude)**/__pycache__/**' >/dev/null 2>&1; git -C "$REPO" commit -m "$MSG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: 마지막 커밋 후 경과 시간 확인 중...
